“Our team continues to execute on our business plan by adding new clients and deepening our relationships with existing ones, further diversifying into new asset classes, and optimizing our capital platform,” said HASI President and Chief Executive Officer Jeffrey A. Lipson. “These factors have translated into superb financial results through the first three quarters of 2026 with our Managed Assets increasing nearly $3 billion to $19 billion, Adjusted Recurring Net Investment Income growing 23% and Adjusted EPS by 15% year-to-date, and our Adjusted ROE rising to 15.6%.”
Revenue growth

A company’s long-term revenue performance can indicate its overall quality. Any business can have short-term success, but a top-tier one grows for years. Over the last five years, HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital grew its revenue at an impressive 16.2% compounded annual growth rate. Its growth beat the average financials company and shows its offerings resonate with customers.

children: Long-term growth is the most important, but within financials, a half-decade historical view may miss recent interest rate changes and market returns. HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital’s recent performance shows its demand has slowed significantly as its annualized revenue growth of 4.7% over the last two years was well below its five-year trend.

This quarter, HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital’s revenue fell by 17.8% year on year to $114.5 million but beat Wall Street’s consensus estimates by 8%.
Key takeaways from HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital’s Q3 results

A sizable revenue beat and EPS above Wall Street’s estimates gave HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital’s Q3 results some clear positives, making this a solid quarter overall. Revenue came in well above analysts’ consensus estimates. Shares remained flat at $39.62 immediately after the release.

The latest quarter is only one piece of HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital’s longer-term business quality puzzle. Quality, combined with valuation, can help determine whether the stock is a buy at its current price.
